card.name: Units after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit word (mg, mL) right after a dose number in dosing text. Also fires on a word like 'those' or 'children' that starts a list or a parallel phrase.

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: mg or mL directly after a numeric dose amount, often in a range or schedule.
modes.example: Dexamethasone 20<< mg>> intravenously Completed at least 1

modes.label: Parallel phrase starter
modes.description: A word like 'those' or 'children' that starts a repeated phrase, before an age range or a possessive.

card.writes: It suppresses linking words like from, with, without and toward, so the text is steered away from them after the dose unit.
card.plain: It fires on mg or mL right after a dose number, and sometimes on words like 'those' or 'children' that begin a repeated phrase.
